mapper.sql: create_time , update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, basic_class, classify_id, classify_name, specification, material_is_whole, warehouse_type, type, bool_party_a, project_id, quantity, mete, unit_net, length, width, thickness, theory_thickness, brand, color, heat_no_and_batch_no, workshop_id, warehouse_id, invoice_type, tax_rate, unit_price_excluding_vat, unit_price, amount_excluding_vat, amount, input_vat, standard_id, standard_name
mapper.select: select sum(mete) mete, sum(quantity) quantity, sum(input_VAT) inputVAT, sum(amount) amount, sum(amount_excluding_VAT) amountExcludingVAT from wms_statistics_inbound where statistics_id = #{id}

select DATE_FORMAT(create_time,'%m') date, case when #{type} = 1 then ifnull(sum(amount),0) when #{type} = 2 then ifnull(sum(amount_excluding_vat),0) END amount from wms_statistics_inbound where bool_delete_enum = 0 and basic_class & #{basicClass} > 0 and date_format(create_time, '%Y') = date_format(#{year}, '%Y') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time,'%m')
